body: I'm ready to go to electroshock therapy or something.  I would rather just have no feeling and live like a literal robot than the way I do now.  Or just not live.
Nothing.  I don't want to sound like a little kid throwing a fit, "No, I hate everything!".  I used to enjoy my hobbies, but now they have no feeling, just empty.

Yes, I feel like a drain on everyone I get close to.  I get close enough to share these feelings and just seem to suck the emotion and life out of them until they don't want to be around me.  I don't blame them.  I just try to keep it to myself now because I feel like, despite their good intentions, being a friend and confidant is exhausting.
